lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical line segments; spacing is approximately 50-70 pixels between lines in the mid-torso, narrowing and becoming less defined in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 9, 10, and 11 exhibit truncation, failing to extend to the dorsal crest or the ventral margin compared to the more continuous segments 3 through 7.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A sparse cluster of two primary high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, with a third smaller, less defined spot positioned on the posterior-most edge of the thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two primary spots on the haunch align on a near-horizontal axis, creating a short geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns display a lyrate curvature, projecting posterodorsally at an approximate 70-degree angle from the frontal bone with a medial inward turn at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.2 times the combined width of the horn bases at the pedicles.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping constitutes approximately 12% of the total vertical horn length from the base to the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white facial chevron between the orbits, white cheek spots, and high-contrast orange pelage on the lower limbs starting below the carpus and tarsus.
